description: Práctica intensiva para consolidar tiempos de futuro, condicionales 1 y 2, y reciclar modales y cláusulas relativas.

exercises.title: Future Tenses Contrast (Will, Going to, Present Continuous)
exercises.instruction: Elige la forma de futuro correcta para completar las oraciones. Presta atención al contexto (decisiones espontáneas, intenciones, predicciones o planes confirmados).
items: 1. I've bought the tickets! We ___ (fly / are flying) to Tokyo next month to see the new smart city.
2. Look at those dark clouds! It ___ (is going to rain / will rain) heavily.
3. A: 'I don't know how to use this new app.' B: 'Don't worry, I ___ (will show / am showing) you.'
4. Next year, the government ___ (is going to build / building) a new renewable energy plant. The plans are already approved.
5. I think people ___ (will drive / are driving) flying cars in 2050, but I'm not sure.
6. We ___ (are meeting / will meet) the environmental committee at 10 AM tomorrow. It's in my calendar.
7. A: 'We have no milk.' B: 'Really? I ___ (will go / am going to go) to the supermarket now to buy some.'
8. A: 'Why are you taking your laptop?' B: 'Because I ___ (am going to work / will work) on the train.'
9. The new smartphones ___ (will probably cost / are probably costing) a lot of money next year.
10. I ___ (am having / will have) lunch with my boss on Friday to discuss the new project.

exercises.title: Conditionals: Real or Hypothetical?
exercises.instruction: Completa las oraciones con la forma correcta de los verbos entre paréntesis para formar First o Second Conditionals.
items: 1. If we ___ (use) more renewable energy, climate change ___ (slow) down. (First Conditional - Real possibility)
2. If I ___ (be) the president, I ___ (ban) all plastic bags. (Second Conditional - Hypothetical)
3. What ___ you ___ (do) if you ___ (lose) your smartphone? (Second Conditional)
4. If she ___ (not/study) hard, she ___ (not/pass) the university exam tomorrow. (First Conditional)
5. We ___ (save) a lot of water if everyone ___ (take) shorter showers. (Second Conditional)
6. If the new app ___ (be) successful, the company ___ (make) millions. (First Conditional)
7. I ___ (buy) an electric car if I ___ (have) enough money, but they are too expensive. (Second Conditional)
8. If we ___ (not/recycle) our garbage, the pollution ___ (get) worse. (First Conditional)

exercises.title: Spot the B1 Mistakes
exercises.instruction: Encuentra el error gramatical en cada oración y escribe la versión correcta. ¡Busca errores clásicos de condicionales y futuros!
items: 1. If it will rain tomorrow, we will stay at home.
2. I promise I am going to help you with your homework tonight.
3. If I have a million dollars, I would travel around the world.
4. What would you do if you win the lottery?
5. We are going to a meeting at 3 PM tomorrow, it's on our schedule.

exercises.title: Key Word Transformations (Integrated Review)
exercises.instruction: Reescribe las oraciones manteniendo el significado exacto, usando la palabra entre paréntesis. ¡Este ejercicio incluye Modales y Relative Clauses de las clases 2 y 3!
items: 1. It is a good idea to install this new security app. (SHOULD) -> You ____________________ this new security app.
2. It is not necessary for us to print these documents. (HAVE) -> We ____________________ print these documents.
3. I am planning to buy a new smart TV next week. (GOING) -> I ____________________ a new smart TV next week.
4. I advise you to recycle plastic. (OUGHT) -> You ____________________ plastic.
5. The man is a scientist. He invented the new battery. (WHO) -> The man ____________________ is a scientist.
6. It is strictly prohibited to throw batteries in the normal bin. (MUSTN'T) -> You ____________________ batteries in the normal bin.
